mechanism: Adapalene is a topical retinoid that may increase skin irritation, photosensitivity, and systemic absorption when combined with everolimus, which causes skin toxicities including rash and photosensitivity as known adverse effects.
action: Monitor for increased dermatologic adverse effects; counsel patient on strict sun protection, consider temporary discontinuation of one agent if severe skin reactions occur, and assess whether adapalene can be replaced with alternative acne therapy.
